claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 28B's first-token null is not rescued by the preregistered phrase-mean or phrase-last readouts under the matching Stage 9 Noetic probes.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: A preregistered phrase-level readout, using the matching Stage 9 readout probe, reads canonical Noetic colloquialisms above the corrected gates on Pythia-160M.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, Noetic clusters, retrained colloquialism classifiers, 40-Element hard-partner resolution, raw CAS-symbol understanding, free-form generation control, or cross-model generality from Stage 28C.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 28C tests phrase-level readout positions for single Noetic colloquialisms on Pythia-160M. It does not test Noetic clusters, retrained colloquialism probes, full TKS formulas, component-localized covers, exact neurons, or open-ended generation control.

formal_anchor: Noetic colloquialisms are treated as natural-language realizations. This stage changes the measurement position from a token-local readout to a phrase-level readout while preserving the same Stage 9 artifact and the same Stage 28B phrase fixture.

gates.criterion: Stage 9 activation artifact matches the preregistered local replacement contract used by Stage 24B.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: A phrase-level candidate is eligible only if its matching Stage 9 Noetic probe has test accuracy at least 0.50.
gates.name: candidate_probe_floor

gates.criterion: At least one eligible phrase-level candidate has exact Noetic accuracy at least 0.45 and exact-binomial p<0.025 against 10-way chance.
gates.name: corrected_exact_accuracy

gates.criterion: The same passing candidate has mean target probability at least 0.15, i.e. +0.05 over 10-way chance.
gates.name: target_probability_lift

gates.criterion: The same passing candidate has top-2 Noetic accuracy at least 0.65.
gates.name: top2_accuracy

gates.criterion: For rows whose Noetic has a formal involution partner, the same passing candidate beats partner probability on at least 0.60 of rows.
gates.name: involution_partner_margin

gates.criterion: Report the delta from Stage 28B phrase_first exact accuracy; this is diagnostic, not required for PASS.
gates.name: baseline_improvement

method: Commit this pre-registration before any Stage 28C result artifact is generated.
Reuse the exact 40-row Stage 28B colloquialism fixture; do not edit phrases after seeing results.
Fit three collapsed Stage 9 Noetic probes at layer 5: X_focus, X_mean, and X_final.
Run Pythia-160M forward on each carrier sentence and capture all layer-5 token states overlapping the quoted phrase span.
Score phrase_first with the X_focus probe only as the Stage 28B baseline replication.
Score phrase_mean with the X_mean probe and phrase_last with the X_final probe as the two preregistered phrase-level candidates.
Apply a two-candidate correction by requiring exact-binomial p<0.025 for a PASS on either phrase-level candidate.
Report per-Noetic rows and target-vs-involution-partner margins for each readout.
motivation: Stage 28B tested only the first token of each colloquial phrase and returned a bounded null. Stage 28C tests the explicit measurement critique: colloquialisms are phrase-level cognitive acts, so phrase-mean or phrase-last activations may carry the intended Noetic more faithfully than the first token.

baseline_readout.definition: first tokenizer state overlapping the quoted colloquial phrase span

primary_phrase_level_readouts.definition: mean of all tokenizer states overlapping the quoted colloquial phrase span
last tokenizer state overlapping the quoted colloquial phrase span

required_inputs.task: 10-way Noetic realization readout from full-phrase natural-language colloquialisms
